articles.title_en: Auctioning Long-Term Projects under Financial Constraints
articles.title_cn: 在财务紧张的情况下拍卖长期项目
articles.abstract_en: We consider a procurement auction for the provision of a basic service to which an add-on must later be appended. Potential providers are symmetric, have private information on their cost for the basic service and the winning firm must also implement the add-on. To finance value-enhancing activities related to the add-on, this firm may need extra funding by outside financiers. Nonverifiable effort related to these activities creates a moral hazard problem which makes the firm’s payoff function for the second period concave in returns over the relevant range. Concavity has two effects. First, it makes it more attractive to backload payments to facilitate information revelation. Second, uncertainty on the cost of the add-on introduces a background risk which requires a risk premium. In this context, we characterize the optimal intertemporal structure of payments to the winning firm, equilibrium bidding behaviour and reserve prices for a first-price auction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑进行采购拍卖，以提供基本服务，随后必须附加附加服务。潜在的提供商是对称的，拥有有关基本服务成本的私人信息，获胜的公司还必须实施附加服务。为了资助与附加组件相关的增值活动，该公司可能需要外部融资者提供额外资金。与这些活动相关的不可验证的努力会产生道德风险问题，使公司在第二期间的收益函数在相关范围内的回报上呈凹形。凹度有二效应。 第一，它使得延期付款更具吸引力，以促进信息披露。 第二，附加组件成本的不确定性引入了背景风险，需要风险溢价。在这种背景下，我们描述了向获胜公司支付的最优跨期结构、均衡投标行为和第一价格拍卖的底价。

articles.title_en: Markups and Inequality
articles.title_cn: 加价和不平等
articles.abstract_en: We characterize optimal product market policy in an unequal economy in which firm ownership is concentrated and markups increase with firm market shares. We study the problem of a utilitarian regulator who designs revenue-neutral interventions in the product market. We show that optimal policy increases product market concentration. This is because policies that encourage larger producers to expand improve allocative efficiency, increase the demand for labour and equilibrium wages. We derive these results both in a static Mirrleesian setting in which we impose no constraints on the shape of interventions, as well as in a dynamic economy with wealth accumulation. In our dynamic economy optimal policy reduces wealth and income inequality by redistributing market share and profits from medium-sized businesses, which are primarily owned by relatively rich entrepreneurs, to larger diversified corporate firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们描述了不平等经济中最优产品市场政策的特征，在这种经济中，公司所有权集中，加价随着公司市场份额的增加而增加。我们研究了一个功利主义监管者的问题，该监管者在产品市场上设计了收入中性的干预措施。我们表明，最优政策提高了产品市场集中度。这是因为鼓励较​​大生产者扩张的政策提高了配置效率，增加了对劳动力和均衡工资的需求。我们在静态米尔利斯环境（我们对干预措施的形式不施加任何限制）以及财富积累的动态经济中得出了这些结果。在我们充满活力的经济中，最优政策通过将主要由相对富裕的企业家拥有的中型企业的市场份额和利润重新分配给大型多元化企业来减少财富和收入不平等。

articles.title_en: Sowing the Seeds of Financial Crises: Endogenous Asset Creation and Adverse Selection
articles.title_cn: 播下金融危机的种子：内生资产创造和逆向选择
articles.abstract_en: What sows the seeds of financial crises, and what policies can help avoid them? I model the interaction between the ex-ante production of assets and ex-post adverse selection in financial markets. Positive shocks that increase market prices exacerbate the production of low-quality assets and can increase the likelihood of a financial market collapse. The interest rate and the liquidity premium are endogenous and depend on the functioning of financial markets as well as the total supply of assets (private and public). Optimal policy balances the economy’s liquidity needs ex-post with the production incentives ex-ante, and it can be implemented with three instruments: government bonds, asset purchase programs, and transaction taxes. Public liquidity improves incentives but implies a higher deadweight loss than private market interventions. Optimal policy does not rule out private market collapses but mitigates the fluctuations in total liquidity.
articles.abstract_cn: 金融危机的根源是什么？哪些政策可以帮助避免金融危机？我对金融市场中资产的事前生产与事后逆向选择之间的相互作用进行了建模。提高市场价格的积极冲击会加剧低质量资产的生产，并可能增加金融市场崩溃的可能性。利率和流动性溢价是内生的，取决于金融市场的运作以及资产的总供应（私人和公共）。最优政策平衡经济的事后流动性需求和事前生产激励，并且可以通过政府债券、资产购买计划和交易税等工具来实施。公共流动性改善了激励措施，但意味着比私人市场干预更高的无谓损失。最优政策并不排除私人市场崩溃，但会减轻总流动性的波动。

articles.title_en: Looming Large or Seeming Small? Attitudes Towards Losses in a Representative Sample
articles.title_cn: 显得大还是显得小？代表性样本对损失的态度
articles.abstract_en: We measure individual-level loss aversion using three incentivized, representative surveys of the U.S. population (combined N=3,000). We find that around 50% of the U.S. population is loss tolerant—they are willing to accept negative-expected-value gambles that contain a loss. This is counter to expert predictions and earlier findings—which mostly come from laboratory/student samples—that 70–90% of participants are loss averse. Consistent with the different findings in our study versus the prior literature, loss aversion is more prevalent in people with high cognitive ability. Further, our measure of gain–loss attitudes exhibits similar temporal stability and better predictive power outside our survey than measures of risk aversion. Loss-tolerant individuals are more likely to report recent gambling, investing a higher percentage of their assets in stocks, and experiencing financial shocks. These results support the general hypothesis that individuals value gains and losses differently, and that gain–loss attitudes are an important economic preference. However, the tendency in a large proportion of the population to emphasize gains over losses is an overlooked behavioural phenomenon.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用 三 对美国人口进行的激励性代表性调查（合并 N=3,000）来衡量个人层面的损失厌恶。我们发现，大约 50% 的美国人具有损失容忍度——他们愿意接受包含损失的负期望值赌博。这与专家预测和早期发现（主要来自实验室/学生样本）相反，即70-90%参与者厌恶损失。与我们的研究与先前文献的不同发现一致，损失厌恶在认知能力高的人中更为普遍。此外，在我们的调查之外，我们对得失态度的衡量表现出与风险厌恶衡量相似的时间稳定性和更好的预测能力。容忍损失的个人更有可能报告最近赌博、将更高比例的资产投资于股票以及经历金融冲击。这些结果支持了这样一个普遍假设：个体对收益和损失的评价不同，并且收益-损失态度是一种重要的经济偏好。然而，很大一部分人倾向于强调收益而不是损失，这是一种被忽视的行为现象。

articles.title_en: Robustly Optimal Mechanisms for Selling Multiple Goods
articles.title_cn: 销售多种商品的稳健最优机制
articles.abstract_en: We study robustly optimal mechanisms for selling multiple items. The seller maximizes revenue against a worst-case distribution of a buyer’s valuations within a set of distributions, called an “ambiguity” set. We identify the exact forms of robustly optimal selling mechanisms and the worst-case distributions when the ambiguity set satisfies various moment conditions on the values of subsets of goods. The analysis reveals general properties of the ambiguity set that justifies categorical bundling, which includes separate sales and pure bundling as special cases.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究销售多种商品的稳健最优机制。卖方在一组称为“模糊性”的分布中，针对买方估价的最坏情况分布，实现收入最大化。当模糊集满足商品子集值的各种矩条件时，我们确定了鲁棒最优销售机制的确切形式和最坏情况分布。该分析揭示了模糊集的一般属性，这些属性证明了分类捆绑的合理性，其中包括作为特殊情况的单独销售和纯捆绑。

articles.title_en: Standard Errors for Calibrated Parameters
articles.title_cn: 校准参数的标准误差
articles.abstract_en: Calibration, the practice of choosing the parameters of a structural model to match certain empirical moments, can be viewed as minimum distance estimation. Existing standard error formulas for such estimators require a consistent estimate of the correlation structure of the empirical moments, which is often unavailable in practice. Instead, the variances of the individual empirical moments are usually readily estimable. Using only these variances, we derive conservative standard errors and confidence intervals for the structural parameters that are valid even under the worst-case correlation structure. In the over-identified case, we show that the moment weighting scheme that minimizes the worst-case estimator variance amounts to a moment selection problem with a simple solution. Finally, we develop tests of over-identifying or parameter restrictions. We apply our methods empirically to a model of menu cost pricing for multi-product firms and to a heterogeneous agent New Keynesian model.
articles.abstract_cn: 校准，即选择结构模型的参数来匹配某些经验矩的实践，可以被视为最小距离估计。此类估计量的现有标准误差公式需要对经验矩的相关结构进行一致估计，而这在实践中通常是不可用的。相反，各个经验矩的方差通常很容易估计。仅使用这些方差，我们得出即使在最坏情况相关结构下也有效的结构参数的保守标准误差和置信区间。在过度识别的情况下，我们证明了最小化最坏情况估计方差的矩加权方案相当于具有简单解决方案的矩选择问题。最后，我们开发了过度识别或参数限制的测试。我们根据经验将我们的方法应用于多产品公司的菜单成本定价模型和异质代理新凯恩斯模型。

articles.title_en: Direct and Indirect Effects of Subsidized Dual Apprenticeships
articles.title_cn: 补贴双元学徒的直接和间接影响
articles.abstract_en: Public interventions in the apprenticeship market often aim to increase demand or returns. We set up a double-sided experiment with youth and firms to analyse a subsidized dual apprenticeship program. This intervention seeks to relax financial constraints for youth by offering a wage subsidy and to make apprenticeship more attractive by providing vocational training in technical skills that complements on-the-job training. We document a large increase in youth participation in apprenticeship, yet the inflow of apprentices induces little crowding out of traditional apprentices in firms. The intervention leads to an increase in youth demand for apprenticeship, enabling firms to fill open apprenticeship positions. The subsidy compensates apprentices for low wages but does not alleviate financial constraints. Consistent with the dual training component contributing to an increase in youth demand for apprenticeship, youth perform more complex tasks and have higher earnings 4 years after the start of the experiment.
articles.abstract_cn: 对学徒市场的公共干预往往旨在增加需求或回报。我们与青年和企业进行了双边实验，以分析补贴双元学徒计划。这项干预措施旨在通过提供工资补贴来放松年轻人的经济限制，并通过提供补充在职培训的技术技能职业培训来提高学徒期的吸引力。我们记录了年轻人参与学徒制的人数大幅增加，但学徒的流入并没有导致公司中传统学徒的排挤。干预措施导致年轻人对学徒的需求增加，使公司能够填补空缺的学徒职位。该补贴补偿了学徒的低工资，但并没有缓解财务压力。与双元培训部分导致青年学徒需求增加的情况一致，青年人在实验开始几年后执行更复杂的任务并获得更高的收入4。

articles.title_en: Untying the Knot: How Child Support and Alimony Affect Couples’ Dynamic Decisions and Welfare
articles.title_cn: 解开这个结：子女抚养费和赡养费如何影响夫妻的动态决策和福利
articles.abstract_en: In many countries, divorce law mandates post-marital maintenance payments (child support and alimony) to insure the lower earner in married couples against financial losses upon divorce. This paper studies how maintenance payments affect couples’ intertemporal decisions and welfare. I develop a dynamic model of family labour supply, home production, savings, and divorce and estimate it using Danish register and survey data. The model captures the policy tradeoff between providing insurance to the lower earner and enabling couples to specialise efficiently, on the one hand, and maintaining labour supply incentives for divorcees, on the other hand. I use the estimated model to study various counterfactual policy scenarios. I find that alimony comes with more substantial labour supply disincentives compared to child support payments and is less efficient in providing consumption insurance. The welfare maximising policy, within the status quo policy space, involves increasing child support and reducing alimony payments. My results show that Pareto improvements beyond this welfare maximising policy are feasible, highlighting limitations of how child support and alimony policies are commonly implemented.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多国家，离婚法强制要求支付婚后赡养费（子女抚养费和赡养费），以确保已婚夫妇中收入较低的人在离婚时免受经济损失。本文研究赡养费如何影响夫妻的跨期决策和福利。我开发了一个家庭劳动力供应、家庭生产、储蓄和离婚的动态模型，并使用丹麦登记和调查数据对其进行估计。该模型体现了政策权衡，一方面向低收入者提供保险，使夫妇能够有效地专业化，另一方面维持对离婚者的劳动力供应激励。我使用估计模型来研究各种反事实政策情景。我发现，与子女抚养费相比，赡养费会带来更严重的劳动力供应抑制因素，并且在提供消费保险方面效率较低。在现状政策空间内，福利最大化政策涉及增加子女抚养费和减少赡养费。我的结果表明，超越福利最大化政策的帕累托改进是可行的，突显了子女抚养和赡养费政策通常实施方式的局限性。

articles.title_en: Who Bears the Welfare Costs of Monopoly? The Case of the Credit Card Industry
articles.title_cn: 谁承担垄断的福利成本？信用卡行业案例
articles.abstract_en: We measure the distribution of welfare losses from non-competitive behaviour in the U.S. credit card industry during the 1970s and 1980s. The early credit card industry was characterized by regional monopolies. Ensuing legal decisions led to competitive reforms that resulted in greater, but still limited, oligopolistic competition. We measure the distributional consequences of these reforms by developing and estimating a heterogeneous agent, defaultable debt framework with oligopolistic lenders. The transition from monopoly to oligopolistic competition yields welfare gains equivalent to a one-time transfer worth $3,600 (in 2016 dollars) for the bottom decile of earners (roughly 50% of their annual income) versus $1,200 for the top decile of earners. As the credit market expands, low-income households benefit more since they rely disproportionately on credit to smooth consumption. Greater competition also explains rising bankruptcies, chargeoffs, and credit to income ratios. Lastly, we bound the welfare gains from competition by computing a perfectly competitive benchmark. Aggregate welfare gains are 40% larger from perfect competition but distributed similarly to oligopolistic competition.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们衡量1970和1980期间美国信用卡行业非竞争行为造成的福利损失的分布。早期的信用卡行业具有区域垄断的特点。随后的法律决定导致了竞争性改革，导致了更大但仍然有限的寡头垄断竞争。我们通过与寡头垄断贷款人开发和估计异质代理、可违约债务框架来衡量这些改革的分配后果。从垄断到寡头垄断竞争的转变所产生的福利收益相当于收入最低十分之一的人（大约是其年收入的3,600）的一时间转移价值$2016（以50%美元计），而收入最高的十分之一的人则为$1,200美元。随着信贷市场的扩大，低收入家庭受益更多，因为他们过度依赖信贷来平稳消费。更激烈的竞争也解释了破产、冲销和信贷与收入比率上升的原因。最后，我们通过计算完全竞争基准来限制竞争带来的福利收益。完全竞争带来的总福利收益40%更大，但分布与寡头垄断竞争类似。

articles.title_en: Moment Conditions for Dynamic Panel Logit Models with Fixed Effects
articles.title_cn: 具有固定效应的动态面板 Logit 模型的力矩条件
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the construction of moment conditions in discrete choice panel data with individual-specific fixed effects. We describe how to systematically explore the existence of moment conditions that do not depend on the fixed effects, and we demonstrate how to construct them when they exist. Our approach is closely related to the numerical “functional differencing” construction introduced in a seminal paper by Bonhomme, but our emphasis is to find explicit analytic expressions for the moment functions. We first explain the construction and give examples of such moment conditions in various models. Then, we focus on the dynamic binary choice logit model and explore the implications of the moment conditions for the identification and estimation of the model parameters that are common to all individuals.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有个体特定固定效应的离散选择面板数据中矩条件的构造。我们描述了如何系统地探索不依赖于固定效应的矩条件的存在，并演示了如何在它们存在时构建它们。我们的方法与 Bonhomme 的一篇开创性论文中引入的数值“函数微分”结构密切相关，但我们的重点是找到矩函数的显式解析表达式。我们第一解释了这种结构并给出了各种模型中此类力矩条件的示例。然后，我们关注动态二元选择 Logit 模型，并探讨矩条件对所有个体共有的模型参数的识别和估计的影响。

articles.title_en: Rational Expectations Models with Higher-Order Beliefs
articles.title_cn: 具有高阶信念的理性预期模型
articles.abstract_en: We develop a method of solving rational expectations models with dispersed information and dynamic strategic complementarities. In these types of models, the equilibrium outcome hinges on an infinite number of higher-order expectations which require an increasing number of state variables to keep track of. Despite this complication, we prove that the equilibrium outcome always admits a finite-state representation when the signals follow finite ARMA processes. We also show that such a finite-state result may not hold with endogenous information aggregation. We further illustrate how to use the method to derive comparative statics, characterize equilibrium outcomes in HANK-type network games, reconcile with empirical evidence on expectations, and integrate incomplete information with bounded rationality in general equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种解决具有分散信息和动态战略互补性的理性预期模型的方法。在这些类型的模型中，均衡结果取决于无限数量的高阶期望，这些期望需要越来越多的状态变量来跟踪。尽管存在这种复杂性，我们还是证明，当信号遵循有限 ARMA 过程时，均衡结果总是允许有限状态表示。我们还表明，这样的有限状态结果可能不适用于内生信息聚合。我们进一步说明如何使用该方法推导比较静态，描述 HANK 型网络博弈中的均衡结果，与预期的经验证据相协调，并将不完整信息与一般均衡中的有限理性相结合。

articles.title_en: The Child Penalty Atlas
articles.title_cn: 儿童刑罚图集
articles.abstract_en: This paper builds a world atlas of child penalties in employment based on microdata from 134 countries. The estimation of child penalties is based on pseudo-event studies of first child birth using cross-sectional data. The pseudo-event studies are validated against true event studies using panel data for a subset of countries. Most countries display clear and sizable child penalties: men and women follow parallel trends before parenthood, but diverge sharply and persistently after parenthood. While this pattern is pervasive, there is enormous variation in the magnitude of the effects across different regions of the world. The fraction of gender inequality explained by child penalties varies systematically with economic development and proxies for structural transformation. At low levels of development, child penalties represent a minuscule fraction of gender inequality. But as economies develop—incomes rise and the labour market transitions from subsistence agriculture to salaried work in industry and services—child penalties take over as the dominant driver of gender inequality. The relationship between child penalties and development is validated using historical data from current high-income countries, back to the 1700s for some countries. Finally, because parenthood is often tied to marriage, we also investigate the existence of marriage penalties in female employment. In general, women experience both marriage and child penalties, but their relative importance depends on the level of development. The development process is associated with a substitution from marriage penalties to child penalties, with the former gradually converging to zero.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文根据134个国家的微观数据构建了就业中儿童处罚的世界地图集。对儿童处罚的估计是基于使用横截面数据对第一分娩进行的伪事件研究。使用部分国家的面板数据对照真实事件研究对伪事件研究进行了验证。大多数国家都表现出明确且相当大的儿童惩罚：男性和女性在成为父母之前遵循相似的趋势，但在成为父母之后却出现了急剧而持久的分歧。虽然这种模式很普遍，但世界不同地区的影响程度存在巨大差异。儿童惩罚所解释的性别不平等比例随着经济发展和结构转型的变化而系统性地变化。在发展水平较低的情况下，对儿童的惩罚只占性别不平等的一小部分。但随着经济发展，收入增加，劳动力市场从自给农业转向工业和服务业的带薪工作，对儿童的惩罚成为性别不平等的主要驱动因素。儿童惩罚与发展之间的关系是使用当前高收入国家的历史数据进行验证的，对于某些国家来说可以追溯到1700。最后，由于为人父母往往与婚姻联系在一起，我们还调查了女性就业中是否存在婚姻惩罚。一般来说，女性都会经历婚姻和孩子的惩罚，但它们的相对重要性取决于发展水平。其发展过程是从婚姻刑到子女刑的替代，并逐渐趋向于零。

articles.title_en: A Dynamic Model of Authoritarian Social Control
articles.title_cn: 威权社会控制的动态模型
articles.abstract_en: Authoritarian regimes often use targeted social control—unequal application of the law to limit expressive freedom and enforce social conformity. At the same time, their methods appear less draconian than in the past. In this model, an authority structures punishments and rewards to compel adherence to its preferred norm. The authority’s commitment is time-limited and depends on imperfectly informative signals of a citizen’s behaviour. Given two citizens with the same observed behaviour, the authority imposes harsher punishments on the poorer and/or ex ante dissident individual. Lighter punishments are imposed on the wealthier citizen to prevent “over-compliance”. Wealth inequality increases over time. Some citizens become prosperous “lackeys” while others become destitute from confiscation. In stable regimes with high state capacity, the authority reduces punishments and/or increases rewards to allow citizens to accumulate wealth, leading to social conformity and balanced growth in the long run. In unstable regimes with low capacity, the citizenry splits into groups of wealthy lackeys and destitute proles.
articles.abstract_cn: 独裁政权经常使用有针对性的社会控制——不平等的法律适用来限制言论自由并强制社会整合。与此同时，他们的方法似乎不像过去那么严厉。在这个模型中，权威机构通过惩罚和奖励来迫使人们遵守其偏好的规范。当局的承诺是有时间限制的，并且取决于公民行为的不完全信息信号。鉴于二公民具有相同的观察行为，当局对较贫穷和/或事前持不同政见者施加更严厉的惩罚。对富裕公民实施较轻的惩罚，以防止“过度遵守”。财富不平等随着时间的推移而加剧。一些公民成为富裕的“走狗”，而另一些公民则因没收而变得一贫如洗。在国家能力较高的稳定政权中，当局会减少惩罚和/或增加奖励，以允许公民积累财富，从而导致社会整合和长期平衡增长。在能力低下、不稳定的政权中，公民分裂为富有的走狗和贫困的无产阶级。

articles.title_en: On the Family Origins of Human Capital Formation: Evidence from Donor Children
articles.title_cn: 人力资本形成的家庭起源：来自捐助儿童的证据
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a novel strategy to study the intergenerational transmission of human capital skills, net of genetic skill transfers. For this purpose, we use unique Danish data on children conceived through sperm and egg donation in in vitro fertilization treatments to estimate the relationship between child test scores and parental years of schooling. Because the assignment of donors is not selective, these parental schooling estimates allow for a causal nurture interpretation. Once we take account of genes, we find that only the education of mothers matters: the association between father’s education and child test scores (in reading and math) is insignificant and practically zero, whereas the association between mother’s education and child test scores (in reading, not in math) is significant and large, and as large as the association we estimate for mothers of non-donor children.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种新颖的策略来研究人力资本技能的代际传递（扣除遗传技能转移）。为此，我们使用丹麦独特的体外受精治疗中通过捐赠精子和卵子受孕的儿童数据来估计儿童测试成绩与父母受教育年限之间的关系。由于捐赠者的分配不是选择性的，这些父母受教育程度的估计允许对因果养育进行解释。一旦我们考虑到基因，我们就会发现只有母亲的教育才重要：父亲的教育和孩子的考试成绩（阅读和数学）之间的关联微不足道，而且几乎零，而母亲的教育和孩子的考试成绩（阅读，而不是数学）之间的关联是显着且很大的，与我们对非捐赠儿童的母亲估计的关联一样大。

articles.title_en: The Causes of Ukrainian Famine Mortality, 1932–33
articles.title_cn: 乌克兰饥荒死亡的原因，1932-33
articles.abstract_en: We construct a novel panel dataset for interwar Soviet Union to study the causes of Ukrainian famine mortality (Holodomor) during 1932–3 and document several facts: (1) Ukraine produced enough food in 1932 to avoid famine in Ukraine; (2) 1933 mortality in the Soviet Union was increasing in the pre-famine ethnic Ukrainian population share and (3) was unrelated to food productivity across regions; (4) this pattern exists even outside of Ukraine; (5) migration restrictions exacerbated mortality; (6) actual and planned grain procurement were increasing and actual and planned grain retention (production minus procurement) were decreasing in the ethnic Ukrainian population share across regions. The results imply that anti-Ukrainian bias in Soviet policy contributed to high Ukrainian famine mortality, and that this bias systematically targeted ethnic Ukrainians across the Soviet Union.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为两次世界大战期间的苏联构建了一个新颖的面板数据集，以研究1932-3期间乌克兰饥荒死亡（Holodomor）的原因，并记录了几个事实：（1）乌克兰在1932生产了足够的粮食以避免乌克兰发生饥荒； (2) 1933 苏联的死亡率在饥荒前的乌克兰族人口中所占比例不断增加，并且 (3) 与各地区的粮食生产力无关； (4)这种模式甚至在乌克兰之外也存在； (5) 移民限制加剧了死亡率； (6) 各地区乌克兰族人口比例的实际和计划粮食采购量在增加，实际和计划粮食保留量（产量减去采购量）在减少。结果表明，苏联政策中的反乌克兰偏见导致了乌克兰饥荒的高死亡率，而且这种偏见系统性地针对整个苏联的乌克兰族人。

articles.title_en: Electoral Turnovers
articles.title_cn: 选举失误
articles.abstract_en: In most national elections, voters face a key choice between continuity and change. Electoral turnovers occur when the incumbent candidate or party fails to win reelection. To understand how turnovers affect national outcomes, we study all presidential and parliamentary elections held globally between 1946 and 2018. We document the prevalence of turnovers over time and estimate their effects on economic performance, human development, and the quality of democracy. Using a close-elections regression discontinuity design across countries, we show that turnovers improve several measures of country performance. To explain these positive effects, we explore how electoral turnovers affect leader characteristics, shape policy decisions, reduce perceived corruption, and foster accountability.
articles.abstract_cn: 在大多数全国选举中，选民面临着连续性和变革之间的关键选择。当现任候选人或政党未能赢得连任时，就会发生选举更替。为了了解人员更替如何影响国家结果，我们研究了 1946 至 2018 之间全球举行的所有总统和议会选举。我们记录了一段时间内人员流动的普遍情况，并评估了其对经济表现、人类发展和民主质量的影响。通过对各国进行势均力敌的选举回归不连续性设计，我们发现人员更替可以改善衡量国家绩效的多项指标。为了解释这些积极影响，我们探讨了选举更替如何影响领导人特征、影响政策决策、减少腐败并促进问责制。

articles.title_en: Fines and Financial Wellbeing
articles.title_cn: 罚款和财务状况
articles.abstract_en: While survey evidence suggests widespread financial fragility in the U.S., causal evidence on the implications of typical, negative income shocks is scarce. I estimate the impact of speeding fines on household finances using administrative traffic citation records and a panel of credit reports. Event studies reveal that fines averaging $195 are associated with a $34 increase in unpaid bills in collections. Given additional evidence that fine payment explains this effect and that default is the “last resort” for households, I interpret this finding as suggesting rates of inability to meet unplanned expenses which are consistent with the survey evidence. I also find that fines are associated with longer-run declines in credit scores, borrowing limits, and the likelihood of appearing as employed in payroll records covering a subset of large, high-paying employers. This impact on employment situations appears attributable to the diminished financial position of households rather than, e.g. downstream license suspensions.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管调查证据表明美国普遍存在金融脆弱性，但关于典型的负收入冲击影响的因果证据却很少。我使用行政交通罚单记录和一组信用报告来估计超速罚款对家庭财务的影响。事件研究表明，平均罚款195美元与催收中未付账单增加34美元相关。鉴于额外的证据表明罚款支付解释了这种影响，并且违约是家庭的“最后手段”，我将这一发现解释为表明无力支付计划外费用的比率，这与调查证据一致。我还发现，罚款与信用评分、借款限额的长期下降以及在涵盖一部分大型高薪雇主的工资记录中出现的可能性有关。这种对就业状况的影响似乎归因于家庭财务状况的恶化，而不是诸如家庭财务状况的恶化。下游许可证暂停。

articles.title_en: Wealth Taxation and Household Saving: Evidence from Assessment Discontinuities in Norway
articles.title_cn: 财富税和家庭储蓄：来自挪威评估不连续性的证据
articles.abstract_en: Neither theory nor existing empirical evidence support the notion that wealth taxation reduces saving. Theoretically, the effect is ambiguous due to opposing income and substitution effects. Empirically, the effect may be masked by misreporting responses. Using geographic discontinuities in the Norwegian annual net-wealth tax and third-party-reported data on savings, I find that wealth taxation causes households to save more. Each additional NOK of wealth tax increases annual net financial saving by 3.76, implying that households increase saving enough to offset both current and future wealth taxes. This positive effect on saving is primarily financed by increases in labour earnings. These responses are the combination of small negative effects of increasing the marginal tax rates and larger positive effects of increasing average rates. My findings imply that income effects may dominate substitution effects in household responses to rate-of-return shocks, which has implications for both optimal taxation and macroeconomic modelling.
articles.abstract_cn: 理论和现有的经验证据都不支持财富税减少储蓄的观点。理论上，由于收入效应和替代效应相反，这种效应是不明确的。根据经验，这种影响可能会被误报的反应所掩盖。利用挪威年度净财富税的地理不连续性和第三方报告的储蓄数据，我发现财富税导致家庭储蓄更多。每增加挪威克朗财富税，年度净财务储蓄就会增加3.76，这意味着家庭增加的储蓄足以抵消当前和未来的财富税。这种对储蓄的积极影响主要来自于劳动力收入的增加。这些反应是提高边际税率的微小负面影响和提高平均税率的较大积极影响的结合。我的研究结果表明，收入效应可能主导家庭对回报率冲击的反应中的替代效应，这对最优税收和宏观经济模型都有影响。

articles.title_en: The Economics of Financial Stress
articles.title_cn: 财务压力的经济学
articles.abstract_en: We study the psychological costs of financial constraints and their economic consequences. Using a representative survey of U.S. households, we document the prevalence of financial stress in U.S. households and a strong relationship between financial stress and measures of financial constraints. We incorporate financial stress into an otherwise standard dynamic model of consumption and labour supply. We emphasize two key results. First, both financial stress itself and naivete about financial stress are important components of a psychology-based theory of the poverty trap. Sophisticated households, instead, save extra to escape high-stress states because they understand that doing so alleviates the economic consequences of financial stress. Second, the financial stress channel dampens or reverses the counterfactual large negative wealth effect on labour earnings because relieving stress frees up cognitive resources for productive work. Financial stress also has macroeconomic implications for wealth inequality and fiscal multipliers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究财务约束的心理成本及其经济后果。通过对美国家庭的代表性调查，我们记录了美国家庭财务压力的普遍程度以及财务压力与财务约束措施之间的密切关系。我们将财务压力纳入标准的消费和劳动力供给动态模型中。我们强调二关键成果。 第一，财务压力本身和对财务压力的天真都是基于心理学的贫困陷阱理论的重要组成部分。相反，成熟的家庭会额外储蓄以逃避高压力状态，因为他们知道这样做可以减轻财务压力的经济后果。 第二，财务压力渠道抑制或扭转了对劳动收入的反事实的巨大负财富效应，因为缓解压力可以释放用于生产性工作的认知资源。金融压力还对财富不平等和财政乘数产生宏观经济影响。

articles.title_en: Firm Inattention and the Efficacy of Monetary Policy: A Text-Based Approach
articles.title_cn: 企业注意力不集中与货币政策的有效性：基于文本的方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides empirical evidence of the importance of firm attention to macroeconomic dynamics. We construct a text-based measure of attention to macroeconomic news and document that attention is polarized across firms and countercyclical. Differences in attention lead to asymmetric responses to monetary policy: expansionary monetary shocks raise the market values of attentive firms more than those of inattentive firms, and contractionary shocks lower the values of attentive firms by less. Attention also mitigates the effects of macroeconomic uncertainty on firm performance. In a quantitative rational inattention model that is calibrated with this new text-based measure, inattention drives monetary non-neutrality. As average attention varies over the business cycle, so does the efficacy of monetary policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了企业关注宏观经济动态重要性的实证证据。我们构建了一个基于文本的宏观经济新闻关注度衡量标准，并记录了不同公司之间的关注度是两极分化的，并且是反周期的。注意力的差异导致对货币政策的不对称反应：扩张性货币冲击使注意力集中的公司的市场价值比注意力不集中的公司的市场价值提高得更多，而紧缩性冲击使注意力集中的公司的价值降低得更少。注意力还减轻了宏观经济不确定性对公司业绩的影响。在用这种新的基于文本的衡量标准校准的定量理性注意力不集中模型中，注意力不集中会导致货币非中性。由于平均关注度随商业周期的变化而变化，货币政策的效力也随之变化。
